title: 教育：谁能学到，学什么，怎样学
intro: 从课堂项目、成人进修和一次作品修改，认识教育机会、课程内容、不同的学习支持，以及怎样把知识真正用起来。
lesson_md:
教育不只发生在学校里。孩子完成一个小组项目，成年人下班后去上课，刚开始工作的人学习新工具，都在接触新的知识和做事方式。讨论教育时，常会谈到能不能参加、学什么、怎样得到帮助，以及学过之后能做什么。这几个问题彼此相连，却不能只用一个成绩或一张证书代替。 **教育机会：入得了门，也要跟得上课程。** access to education 包括能否报名、到达上课地点、负担费用，以及使用必要材料。有名额却没有合适的上课时间，或者课程在线而家里没有稳定网络，都会影响实际参与。夜间班、借用设备和清楚的课程说明，分别回应不同的困难。 **课程内容：知识、实际技能与合作可以一起学。** curriculum 是一门课程或一所学校安排的学习内容。学科知识帮助人理解原理，practical skills 帮助人完成具体事情，合作则涉及分工、倾听和解释。例如做一个科学项目，既要读懂材料，也要测量、记录，并把结果讲给同伴听；实际技能并不只是动手劳动。 **公平机会：共同目标可以配合不同帮助。** equal opportunity 强调不同背景的人都有参与和发展的机会。每个人拿到同一张纸，不一定就能同样顺利地使用它：有人需要解释生词，有人需要放大文字，有人需要更多练习时间。课程可以保留共同目标，同时改变帮助的方式；这与随意降低要求不是同一件事。 **反馈与结果：告诉你哪里可以改，和告诉你得了多少分不同。** feedback 可以指出一段解释哪里不清楚、操作的哪一步需要重做。一个分数概括了表现，却未必告诉学习者下一步怎样改。把反馈落实为一次修改，再看修改后能否完成任务，才能看清具体的学习变化。 **持续学习：学习安排要接得上现有生活。** 成年人可能因为换岗位、个人兴趣或生活需要重新学习。课程内容有用之外，还要考虑时间、交通、照顾家人和练习机会。能否持续参加常常取决于这些小安排：例如能否提前拿到讲义，缺席以后怎样补上，以及学到的内容有没有机会在生活中使用。 ### 1 · 同一个科学项目，不同的学习支持 A school has several purposes. It can introduce students to knowledge, help them develop useful skills and give them experience of working with others. These purposes do not always require separate lessons. A science project, for example, can involve reading, measuring and explaining a result to a partner. However, students may need different kinds of support to take part. One student may understand the subject but struggle with the language used in class. Another may need more time to practise a skill. A common curriculum can give a class shared goals, while additional support can help students work towards them. **把内容读明白** 学校的几个作用可以在同一个项目中出现：学生读资料、测量，再向同伴解释结果。困难也可能发生在不同位置：有人懂知识，却不熟悉课堂使用的语言；有人需要更多时间练习某项操作。因此，共同课程与额外支持可以并存。老师不必为每一个目标另开一门课，也不能只凭学生在某一步卡住就认为他什么都不会。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **A common curriculum can give a class shared goals, while additional support can help students work towards them.** while 在这里连接两项同时成立的安排：全班有共同目标，不同学生得到额外帮助。work towards a goal 是“朝目标努力”；them 指前面的 shared goals。 **A science project, for example, can involve reading, measuring and explaining a result to a partner.** involve 后接名词或 -ing 形式。三个并列动作 reading、measuring、explaining 说明项目具体包含什么。explain something to someone 是向某人解释某事。 ### 2 · 下班后重返课堂，需要的不只是报名 Leila works in a bakery and wants to learn how to keep simple business records. A nearby college offers an evening course, but the first class begins before her shift ends. She talks to her manager and arranges to start work earlier on Wednesdays. The college lets students borrow a laptop for the term, so she does not need to buy one immediately. At home, she practises entering the bakery's sample orders into a spreadsheet. When she misses a lesson, the tutor sends her the activity sheet and explains what to prepare next. The course becomes manageable because the timetable, equipment and support fit her situation. **把内容读明白** Leila 想学习记录订单等基础业务工作，但报名并没有自动解决时间冲突。她先与经理商量周三提早上班，再使用学校在整个学期内可借用的电脑，暂时不必自己购买。缺课后，活动讲义和下一次课的准备说明让她能接着学。这里的学习机会由上课时间、设备和补课支持共同构成；她在家练习样例订单，也把课程内容接到熟悉的工作情境中。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **The college lets students borrow a laptop for the term, so she does not need to buy one immediately.** let someone do something 中的动词用原形，因此是 lets students borrow，不能加 to。borrow 表示暂时借来使用，buy 才是购买。one 指一台 laptop。 **The course becomes manageable because the timetable, equipment and support fit her situation.** manageable 表示在当前条件下能应付、能安排过来。fit her situation 是符合她的具体情况，不表示课程一定很容易。 ### 3 · 一张批注怎样变成真正的修改 A group of students prepares a small exhibition about their neighbourhood. They collect old photographs, interview shopkeepers and write short captions. When their teacher reads the first draft, she notices that one caption says a street has changed without explaining how. Instead of simply giving it a low mark, she asks the group to compare two photographs and name the differences. The students add details about the shops and the wider pavement. They also divide the remaining work so that everyone has a clear task. By the end, they have used local history, careful observation and teamwork to make the exhibition easier for visitors to understand. **把内容读明白** 学生为社区展览收集照片、采访店主并写说明。老师发现“街道变了”太笼统，便请他们比较两张照片、指出具体差异。修改后的文字补上商店和人行道的信息，游客才更容易理解变化在哪里。这里的反馈包含可执行的下一步，最后的成果也同时用到了地方知识、观察和分工；不能只把它看成写出一段文字的练习。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **Instead of simply giving it a low mark, she asks the group to compare two photographs and name the differences.** instead of 后接 -ing 形式；这里不是只给一个低分，而是提出可以照着做的修改要求。name the differences 指把差异明确说出来。 ### 常用词与搭配 | 词与搭配 | 中文意思与常用结构 | 自然例句 | |---|---|---| | provide access to education | 提供接受教育的机会；provide access to education for adults | Evening classes provide access to education for people who work during the day. | | develop practical skills | 发展实际技能；develop practical skills through a project | Students develop practical skills by planning and completing a group project. | | meet learners' needs | 满足学习者的需要；meet different learners' needs | The tutor uses extra examples to meet learners' needs. | | receive feedback on | 得到关于某项表现或作品的反馈；receive feedback on a first draft | Students receive feedback on their first draft before they revise it. | | put knowledge into practice | 把知识用于实际活动；put new knowledge into practice | The design project gives us a chance to put our knowledge into practice. | | curriculum | 课程内容或课程体系；a broad curriculum | The curriculum includes science, arts and practical projects. | | equal opportunity | 公平参与和发展的机会；give learners an equal opportunity | Students need an equal opportunity to use the course materials. | | take part in | 参加某项活动；take part in a group project | Everyone has a way to take part in the group project. | | work towards a goal | 朝着目标努力；work towards a shared goal | The group works towards a shared goal while members do different tasks. | | ask for clarification | 请求进一步解释清楚；ask for clarification about a task | I ask for clarification when the instructions are unclear. | | make progress | 取得进步；make progress with a skill | She makes progress when she has time to practise between lessons. | | revise a draft | 修改草稿；revise a draft after feedback | We revised the draft after checking the photographs. | ### 几个容易混淆的用法 **learn / study**：study 常指学习的过程或所学领域，learn 常指学到知识、学会做事。I study business at an evening college. 说明在学什么；I have learned how to keep simple records. 说明已经学会什么。两者的侧重点不同。 **feedback / advice**：这两个词通常不可数。可以说 some useful feedback、a piece of advice，不说 a feedback 或 an advice。feedback 多与已经完成的表现相联系；advice 可以是在行动前给出的建议。 **teach / learn**：教师 teach students，学生 learn from a teacher。My aunt taught me to sew. 表示姨妈教我缝纫；I learned to sew from my aunt. 从学习者角度说同一件事。
可选回顾：同样参加一门课，为什么两个人可能需要不同的帮助？

One student may need help with the language, while another needs more time to practise. They can work towards the same goal with different kinds of support.

困难可能在语言、练习时间或设备上；共同目标不要求帮助形式完全相同。

可选回顾：怎样把“收到对初稿的反馈，然后修改”说成一句自然的英文？

Students receive feedback on their first draft before they revise it.

feedback 通常不可数，不写 a feedback。on their first draft 说明反馈针对什么；revise it 指修改这份草稿，不是重新复习整门课程。这里只说 receive feedback 仍没交代反馈的对象。

glossary.example: Evening classes provide access to education for people who work during the day.

glossary.chunk: develop practical skills through a project
glossary.example: Students develop practical skills by planning and completing a group project.
The tutor uses extra examples to meet learners' needs.

glossary.meaning: 得到关于某项表现或作品的反馈
glossary.chunk: receive feedback on a first draft
glossary.example: Students receive feedback on their first draft before they revise it.
The design project gives us a chance to put our knowledge into practice.
The curriculum includes science, arts and practical projects.

glossary.meaning: 公平参与和发展的机会
glossary.example: Students need an equal opportunity to use the course materials.

glossary.chunk: take part in a group project
glossary.example: Everyone has a way to take part in the group project.
The group works towards a shared goal while members do different tasks.

She makes progress when she has time to practise between lessons.

learning_outcomes: 根据具体困难，区分共同学习目标与不同支持方式，并能说出一种对应帮助。
用上课时间、设备或补课安排中的两项，解释有学习名额与实际参加课程的区别。
用 receive feedback on 描述对一份作品得到的反馈，并说出反馈怎样落实为一次修改。

title: 工作：收入、稳定性与生活安排
intro: 认识收入、稳定性、灵活安排和工作中的学习机会，再看同一份工作怎样与通勤、家人和团队合作联系起来。
lesson_md:
一份工作会占去一天中的一段时间，也会带来收入、责任、与人合作的机会，以及新的技能。人们选择工作时重视的条件不同：有人希望收入稳定，有人希望离家近，也有人想学习一项以后能继续使用的技能。把工作内容与工作条件分开看，更容易理解为什么两个人会作不同选择。 **收入与实际开支。** income 是收入，salary 常指按月等固定周期支付的工资。工资相同的两份工作，通勤费、在外吃饭的花费或照顾家人的安排可能不同；上下班花去的时间也会影响生活。比较一份工作时，人们既关心拿到多少钱，也关心为了完成工作需要付出什么。 **稳定性与满意度。** job security 说的是对工作能否继续的稳定预期，job satisfaction 则是对工作内容与体验的满意程度。一个人可能喜欢每天做的事，却担心短期合同到期；也可能岗位稳定，却希望获得更多学习机会。这两种感受可以同时存在。 **灵活时间与灵活地点。** flexible working arrangements 可能让人调整开始工作的时间，也可能允许某些任务在家完成。能晚一点上班，不等于可以随时不上班；在家工作也仍有任务、联络和交付要求。具体是否方便，要看岗位需要什么设备、怎样与同事交接。 **培训与工作经验。** training 可以提供示范、练习和操作说明，work experience 则来自在实际工作中参与任务、处理问题和与人配合。两者可以衔接：先跟有经验的同事观察一次，再自己完成一个步骤，得到反馈后接手更多工作。新人有地方提问，能让不熟悉的任务更容易弄清楚。 **生活协调与工作量。** work-life balance 不要求工作和其他生活各占一半时间，而是让工作责任与休息、家人和个人事务能够协调。workload 是需要处理的工作量；下班时间固定，也可能因为任务太多而经常加班。提前排优先次序、说明完成时间和安排交接，都与日常工作量有关。 ### 1 · 在家还是在现场，要看正在做什么 People may value different things in a job. For one person, a steady income may be the main concern. For another, opportunities to learn or time with family may matter more. Working from home is one possible arrangement, but it does not suit every role or every worker. Someone who writes reports may be able to complete many tasks at home, while a mechanic needs access to vehicles and equipment. Even within an office team, some tasks require quiet concentration and others benefit from direct discussion. Clear responsibilities, suitable equipment and opportunities to ask for help are relevant whether employees work at home or in a shared workplace. **把内容读明白** 写报告的人与修汽车的人，对工作地点和设备的需要不同。即使在同一个办公室团队里，安静写作与直接讨论也适合不同安排。原来有关收入、学习机会和陪伴家人的选择，并没有因为出现远程办公就消失：员工仍需要知道负责什么、使用什么设备、遇到问题找谁。这样才能看见一种安排怎样落实在具体岗位上。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **Someone who writes reports may be able to complete many tasks at home, while a mechanic needs access to vehicles and equipment.** while 在这里表示对比。needs access to 不只是“知道设备在哪里”，还要能够接触和使用设备。equipment 通常不可数，不加复数 -s。 **Some tasks require quiet concentration and others benefit from direct discussion.** 原文这个分句用 some...others... 区分不同任务。benefit from 表示从某种条件中得到帮助；不能因此推成每一种任务都需要同样的工作环境。 ### 2 · 工资相同，生活安排却可能很不同 Nina receives two job offers with the same monthly salary. One office is an hour from her home and offers a structured training programme. The other is a short bus ride away and has regular finishing times. Nina is interested in the training, but she also collects her son from an after-school club twice a week. She asks both employers about starting times, busy periods and how often staff work overtime. After comparing the details, she chooses the nearer office and asks whether she can take a course later. Her decision is about more than pay: she wants a job that she can fit into her current life. **把内容读明白** Nina 面对的两份工作月薪相同，但第一份通勤长、有成套培训，第二份离家近、下班时间较固定。她需要每周两次接孩子，所以进一步询问开始上班时间、繁忙时段和加班频率，而不是只看招聘信息里的月薪。最后她选了较近的办公室，同时询问以后学习课程的机会；她没有否认培训的价值，只是把眼前生活需要一起考虑。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **She asks both employers about starting times, busy periods and how often staff work overtime.** how often 问频率，work overtime 是加班。询问这几项能具体了解工作时间；regular finishing times 说下班时间通常固定，不自动表示从不加班。 ### 3 · 新人怎样从观察过渡到自己完成 In his first week at a repair shop, Leo follows an experienced colleague rather than working on customer equipment alone. He learns how to record a problem, choose the right tools and check a finished repair. The shop provides training for employees when it buys a new machine. Later, Leo takes responsibility for simple repairs, but he can still ask for guidance. When several jobs arrive together, his colleague helps him decide which ones must be finished first. Leo begins to understand that meeting a deadline involves planning and communication as well as working quickly. Each week, he discusses one task that went well and one that needs more practice. **把内容读明白** Leo 刚进修理店，先跟着同事观察，学会记录问题、选工具和检查结果，然后才接手简单维修。店里购入新机器时另作培训，说明工作经验并不能替代所有新学习。几项任务同时到来时，他还要分清先后、与同事沟通。这里的成长既包括操作熟练，也包括计划和交接；允许提问不是取消责任，而是帮助他把责任落实。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **Leo begins to understand that meeting a deadline involves planning and communication as well as working quickly.** meet a deadline 是按截止时间完成；as well as 后面的 working 与 planning、communication 一起列出要素。句子说需要计划、沟通和速度，而不只是动作快。 ### 常用词与搭配 | 词与搭配 | 中文意思与常用结构 | 自然例句 | |---|---|---| | earn a living | 谋生；获得维持生活的收入；earn a living by doing something | Some people earn a living by repairing household equipment. | | gain work experience | 获得工作经验；gain work experience at a local business | A placement gives students a chance to gain work experience. | | balance work and family responsibilities | 协调工作与家庭责任；help someone balance work and family responsibilities | Flexible starting times help Nina balance work and family responsibilities. | | work flexible hours | 在一定范围内灵活安排工作时间；work flexible hours during the week | She works flexible hours but attends the weekly team meeting. | | provide training for employees | 为员工提供培训；provide training for employees using new equipment | The company provides training for employees who need to use new equipment. | | job security | 工作能否持续的稳定性；be concerned about job security | Staff are concerned about job security when a short contract is ending. | | steady income | 较稳定、规律的收入；have a steady income | A steady income helps her plan the household budget. | | workload | 需要处理的工作量；share the workload | The team shares the workload during busy weeks. | | meet a deadline | 按截止时间完成任务；meet the deadline for a report | We need to agree on the main points early to meet the deadline. | | work overtime | 加班；work overtime during a busy period | I sometimes work overtime when several repairs arrive on the same day. | | ask for guidance | 请人给予指导；ask a colleague for guidance | New employees can ask an experienced colleague for guidance. | | commute | 定期往返住所与工作地点；通勤；commute to work by bus | I commute to work by bus and read during the journey. | ### 几个容易混淆的用法 **job / work**：job 通常可数，表示一份职位或一项具体任务：She has a new job. work 常泛指工作，通常不可数：I have a lot of work today. 不把 a lot of works 用来表示今天有很多工作要做。 **employer / employee**：employer 是雇主，employee 是雇员。The employer provides equipment for employees. 两个词结尾不同，句子中的责任也不同。 **experience / an experience**：谈工作中积累的经验，常说 work experience、some experience。an experience 指一次经历，例如 My first day in the workshop was a memorable experience. 不说 gain many work experiences 来泛指积累经验。
可选回顾：两份工作月薪一样，为什么还值得询问其他细节？

The journey, finishing times and training opportunities may be different. A nearer job could fit family responsibilities better, while another role might offer more structured training.

通勤、实际工时和学习机会会改变日常生活；选择不只是比较工资高低。

可选回顾：一个人可以在八点至十点间开始工作，但周三十点必须开会。怎样用一句英文说明？

She works flexible hours, but she attends the team meeting at ten on Wednesdays.

前半句说工作时间有一定弹性，后半句保留明确责任；flexible 不表示所有时间都由她随意决定。这些信息也没有说明她可以在家工作。

glossary.meaning: 谋生；获得维持生活的收入
glossary.chunk: earn a living by doing something
glossary.example: Some people earn a living by repairing household equipment.

glossary.chunk: gain work experience at a local business
glossary.example: A placement gives students a chance to gain work experience.

glossary.chunk: help someone balance work and family responsibilities
glossary.example: Flexible starting times help Nina balance work and family responsibilities.

glossary.meaning: 在一定范围内灵活安排工作时间
glossary.chunk: work flexible hours during the week
glossary.example: She works flexible hours but attends the weekly team meeting.

glossary.chunk: provide training for employees using new equipment
glossary.example: The company provides training for employees who need to use new equipment.

glossary.meaning: 工作能否持续的稳定性
glossary.example: Staff are concerned about job security when a short contract is ending.
A steady income helps her plan the household budget.
The team shares the workload during busy weeks.

glossary.chunk: meet the deadline for a report
glossary.example: We need to agree on the main points early to meet the deadline.

glossary.chunk: work overtime during a busy period
glossary.example: I sometimes work overtime when several repairs arrive on the same day.
New employees can ask an experienced colleague for guidance.

glossary.meaning: 定期往返住所与工作地点；通勤
glossary.example: I commute to work by bus and read during the journey.

learning_outcomes: 比较两份同薪工作时，能指出通勤、时间安排和培训机会中的至少两项差别及其影响。
区分在家工作与灵活工时，能用任务和设备解释一种岗位安排。
用 work flexible hours 描述有时间弹性但仍有固定团队责任的工作。

title: 科技：工具带来什么，又需要什么条件
intro: 从线上活动、数字服务和自动处理小任务，了解设备、技能、个人信息与人的判断怎样一起决定工具是否好用。
lesson_md:
科技在生活中常表现为一件具体工具：用手机预约、和远处的人修改同一份文档、让软件整理订单。它改变的可能只是某一步，也可能增加一种以前没有的选择。理解科技话题，可以先看工具让人做成了什么，再看使用时需要哪些条件，出了问题时又怎样继续办事。 **数字接入：有设备、能联网、用得起来是几件事。** digital access 涉及设备、网络和服务本身能否获得。家里有一部手机，不表示屏幕适合填写复杂表格；能连接网络，也不表示知道怎样注册、上传文件或修改错误。服务转到线上以后，有些人减少了奔波，另一些人仍需要现场或电话帮助。 **数字技能：知道按钮在哪里，也知道操作会产生什么结果。** digital skills 包括查找信息、整理文件、使用软件和处理常见问题。例如共享文档里“查看”和“编辑”权限不同，提交表格与暂存草稿也不同。一个人会刷视频，并不一定熟悉这些操作；清楚的提示和练习机会能帮助使用者逐步掌握。 **自动化：让某些步骤按规则运行。** automation 可以让程序排列姓名、计算总数、发出提醒。它可能省去重复操作，却仍需要有人输入正确资料、设置条件并检查特殊情况。一个步骤自动完成，不代表整个岗位都消失；例如订单总量可自动统计，但临时缺货时仍要有人联系顾客。 **隐私与安全：怎样使用信息，以及谁能接触信息。** data privacy 关注个人信息被收集、使用和分享的方式；security 关注防止未经许可的访问、损坏或丢失。限制登录账号能降低随意访问的风险，但并不直接回答服务为什么收集某项信息。姓名、联系方式和位置等信息，各自需要说清用途。 **方便与可靠：省了一步，也可能多一个需要维护的环节。** 线上会议可以减少往返，预约系统能让人先选时间，但这些便利也依赖网络、电量和系统可用。软件更新、设备修理和求助渠道都是使用的一部分。保留一个电话联系方式或线下办理办法，可以让网络中断时仍有下一步可走。 ### 1 · 同一个工具，为不同生活增加选择 Technology changes the way people carry out particular activities. An online service can let a viewer watch a recorded performance without travelling to a theatre. A shared document can allow colleagues in different places to work on the same report. However, having a tool does not settle every question about its use. People still need a suitable device, a connection and enough knowledge to use the service. They may also want to know what personal information it collects. In some situations, an online option adds a useful choice; in others, people may still prefer direct contact or a physical space. **把内容读明白** 线上演出减少了前往剧院的需要，共享文档让不同地点的同事参与同一份报告。这些便利都针对具体活动，也都需要合适设备、网络和一定操作知识。使用者还可能关心系统收集了什么个人信息。有人喜欢面对面交流或现场空间，不会因为多了一个线上选项就自动改变偏好；工具增加什么选择，与人最终怎样选择，是可以分别理解的。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **A shared document can allow colleagues in different places to work on the same report.** allow someone to do something 表示使某人能够做某事。work on a report 是正在处理、修改报告，不等于报告已经完成。shared document 指多个人可以按设定权限使用的同一份文件。 **People still need a suitable device, a connection and enough knowledge to use the service.** enough knowledge to do something 表示具备做这件事所需要的知识。三个并列条件强调：有设备、能连网和会操作不能互相替代。 ### 2 · 一次网上报名，怎样变得容易完成 Ruth wants to join a pottery class at the community centre. Registration has moved online, and she can open the form on her phone, but she cannot find where to upload the required photograph. At the library, a staff member shows her how to choose a file and check it before submitting. Ruth also notices an optional box asking for permission to send promotional messages. She leaves it unticked because she only wants information about her class. The centre still accepts telephone enquiries. Being able to use the form saves Ruth another journey, while the help at the library makes that option practical for her. **把内容读明白** Ruth 有手机，也打开了报名表，却不知道怎样上传照片。图书馆工作人员示范选文件和提交前检查，才让线上报名真正可用。她同时区分了课程通知与可选推广消息，选择不勾选后者。这里可以看见三层内容：接入服务、学会操作、理解信息使用选项。保留电话咨询则让不熟悉操作的人仍有地方提问。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **She leaves it unticked because she only wants information about her class.** leave something + 形容词表示让某物保持某种状态。leaves it unticked 是“让这个选框保持未勾选”，it 指可选推广消息的选框。 **Being able to use the form saves Ruth another journey.** Being able to use the form 整体作主语。save someone a journey 是让某人少跑一趟，saved 的是一次往返，而不只是车票钱。 ### 3 · 订单统计自动完成，特殊情况仍要有人处理 A small bakery uses software to count the bread orders placed each evening. The system adds up the quantities and prints a list for the morning team. This saves staff from copying every order by hand. One Friday, however, a customer enters the same order twice. The unusually large total catches the manager's attention, and she phones the customer before preparing the bread. She also checks who can open the order list, because it contains names and contact details. The software is useful for routine tasks, but the team still checks unusual entries and decides how to deal with changes or mistakes. **把内容读明白** 面包店的软件负责加总数量、打印清单，员工不必每张订单都手抄。然而顾客重复下单后，程序可能仍会把两笔都算进去。经理发现总量异常，先联系顾客核实，再决定准备多少面包。名单里还有姓名和联系方式，因此谁能打开文件也需要安排。自动统计、异常判断和信息访问是不同环节；这段把“效率提高”具体落在减少抄写这一件事上。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **The software is useful for routine tasks, but the team still checks unusual entries and decides how to deal with changes or mistakes.** routine tasks 是经常重复、步骤相对固定的任务；entries 在这里指录入的订单项目。deal with 表示处理，后面接 changes or mistakes，清楚说明团队仍要负责什么。 ### 常用词与搭配 | 词与搭配 | 中文意思与常用结构 | 自然例句 | |---|---|---| | access information online | 在线获取信息；access information online before a visit | Visitors can access information online before they decide where to go. | | develop digital skills | 学习和发展使用数字工具的技能；develop digital skills at a short course | A short course helps beginners develop digital skills. | | protect personal information | 保护个人信息；protect personal information on a shared device | Staff use separate accounts to help protect personal information. | | carry out routine tasks | 完成常规、重复性的任务；carry out routine tasks automatically | Software can carry out routine tasks such as sorting a list of names. | | reduce the need to travel | 减少出行的需要；reduce the need to travel for meetings | An online meeting reduces the need to travel for a brief discussion. | | digital access | 使用设备、网络与数字服务的条件；improve digital access | Loaned laptops improve digital access for people without a suitable device. | | upload a file | 把文件从设备传到线上系统；upload a photograph as a file | I checked the photograph before uploading the file. | | share a document | 让他人按权限使用同一份文档；share a document with colleagues | We share a document so that everyone can see the latest plan. | | privacy settings | 控制信息分享等方式的设置；check the privacy settings | I check the privacy settings before adding personal details. | | a reliable connection | 稳定、可靠的网络连接；need a reliable connection | The video call needs a reliable connection. | | update software | 更新软件；update software on a device | The technician updated the software before the workshop. | | check for errors | 检查是否有错误；check the list for errors | Someone checks the order list for errors before it is printed. | ### 几个容易混淆的用法 **access / access to**：作动词时直接接宾语：I can access the file. 作名词时常用 have access to：I have access to the file. 不把动词形式写成 access to the file。 **upload / download**：upload 把本机文件传到线上系统；download 把线上文件取到自己的设备。I uploaded my photograph and downloaded the confirmation letter. 两个方向不同。 **information / advice / equipment**：这几个词通常不可数。可以说 some information、a piece of advice、two pieces of equipment，不说 informations 或 equipments。说两台电脑时，直接用 two computers 更具体。
可选回顾：一个网上服务已经上线，为什么有人仍需要帮助？

They may have a device but not know how to complete the steps. Clear instructions and a way to ask for help can make the service easier to use.

上线只提供了办理渠道；设备是否合适、操作是否清楚，以及遇到问题怎样求助，仍会影响实际使用。

可选回顾：软件能加总订单，但出现重复订单要联系顾客核实。怎样说明这两种责任？

The software carries out routine tasks such as adding up orders, while staff check unusual entries with customers.

adding up orders 把 routine tasks 说具体；后半句说明特殊情况仍由员工核实。能正确加总输入内容，不等于能判断顾客是否误下了两次订单。单数主语 software 后用 carries。

用 carry out routine tasks 配合一项具体任务，说明软件做了什么而没有夸大为替代整个岗位。

title: 城市：把住房、交通与公共空间放在一起看
intro: 从找房、赶早班车和改造一块公共场地，理解租金、出行、附近服务与空间使用怎样组成日常城市生活。
lesson_md:
住在一座城市，日常面对的往往是很具体的距离和时间：从家到工作地点要多久，去商店是否需要换车，公园什么时候开放，下雨时走到站点方不方便。住房、交通和公共空间相互连接。一处住宅价格看起来合适，仍要看它能不能接上居民每天要去的地方。 **住房是否负担得起，要与生活预算一起看。** housing affordability 指住房支出与可承担预算的关系。租金低只是一个数字，还要看收入、基本生活开支和出行花费。家庭人数、是否需要独立工作空间、楼层和可达条件也会影响住房需要；房子更大，不一定适合每个人。 **公共交通不只有“有没有这条线路”。** public transport 包括公共汽车、地铁等共同使用的交通服务。站点离家多远、多久一班、首末班时间、票价和换乘是否方便，都会影响使用。一条线路恰好经过家门口，如果第一班晚于上班时间，仍可能不能满足通勤需要。 **公共空间与绿地有重叠，但不完全相同。** public space 可以是广场、公园、开放的步行街等共同使用的地方；green space 强调绿化。铺有石板的公共广场不一定有大片绿地，围起来的私人花园则未必向公众开放。树荫、座位、照明、入口和开放时间，会决定不同居民能怎样使用这些地方。 **距离近与方便到达之间，还有路怎么走。** within walking distance 表示可以步行到达，但路面、过街位置和台阶仍会影响具体出行。推婴儿车、使用轮椅、提着购物袋或行动较慢的人，可能更在意坡道和安全的过街路径。step-free access 是不用经过台阶的进入或通行方式，不只是地图上的直线距离短。 **新建设施以后，还需要运行与维护。** 一座新公园需要清洁、修理和照明，一条公交线需要车辆、人员和持续班次。把停车空间改成活动场地，会改变居民停车、休息和经过这里的方式。听取不同使用者的具体需要，再安排设施与维护，才能把地图上的变化接到生活中。 ### 1 · 选择一处住房，也是在选择每天的路线 A city is more than a collection of buildings. It also connects people with the places they need to reach. Consider a family looking for a home. The rent matters, but so do the distance to work, the route to school and the shops nearby. A flat outside the centre may suit them if transport fits their daily schedule. A park can be useful too, but its entrances and opening hours affect who can use it. These examples show why planning involves choices about both space and services. Different residents may have different priorities. **把内容读明白** 一个家庭找房，不只比较租金，还要同时看工作地点、上学路线、附近商店和可使用的公园。住在市中心以外是否合适，取决于交通是否配合他们的日常时间。公园也不是在地图上看见就能方便使用，入口与开放时间仍然重要。原有这些考虑连起来，说明城市既有建筑和道路，也有持续运转的服务。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **The rent matters, but so do the distance to work, the route to school and the shops nearby.** so do... 表示后面列出的条件也同样重要。rent 是租金；distance、route、shops 是并列主语，所以这里用 do。自然的另一种说法是 These things matter too. 不需要把它读成租金不重要。 **A flat outside the centre may suit them if transport fits their daily schedule.** suit them 是适合这家人的需要；if 补出成立条件，即交通与日常时间安排相配合。outside the centre 只说明不在市中心，并不直接表示偏远或不方便。 ### 2 · 家门口有车站，为什么还是赶不上班 Ben finds a flat with a bus stop just outside the building. At first, he thinks the journey to his new job will be simple. Then he checks the timetable and discovers that the first bus leaves after his early shift begins. The evening service is also less frequent, so a missed connection could mean a long wait. Before signing the rental agreement, he tries another route that involves a short walk to the station. It costs a little more, but it runs early enough. Ben compares the rent and travel costs together instead of judging the flat by its location alone. **把内容读明白** Ben 最初只看见“楼下有站”，后来才发现首班车晚于早班开始时间，晚上也不够频密。站点近并不自动解决出行问题。他实走了一条先步行到车站的路线，确认能赶上班，再把租金与交通花费合起来比较。这里分别出现了位置、运行时间、班次和换乘条件，能帮助读者把“交通方便”说得具体。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **The evening service is also less frequent, so a missed connection could mean a long wait.** less frequent 指班次没有那么频繁，并不一定指每辆车行驶得更慢。a missed connection 是没赶上需要换乘的班次；等待变长与班次间隔有关。 ### 3 · 一块小场地，怎样容纳不同的日常需要 An unused corner beside the local library is being turned into a small public space. Some residents want trees and benches, while others ask for somewhere children can play. A wheelchair user points out that the existing entrance has a step. The planners add a level entrance and leave a clear path through the space. They keep several benches in the shade and include a small play area away from the quietest seats. Library staff also ask who will empty the bins and repair damaged lights. The project is not only about the opening day; it needs to remain useful and pleasant afterwards. **把内容读明白** 图书馆旁的一角变成公共空间，不同居民提出的要求并不完全相同：树荫、座位、玩耍区域和不经过台阶的入口。设计保留清楚通道，并把较安静的座位与玩耍区稍作分开。工作人员还问起垃圾和照明的维护，说明“建成”只是使用的开始。这里没有一种设施能自动满足所有人，需要看各部分摆在哪里、之后由谁照看。 **句子里值得留意的地方** **The project is not only about the opening day; it needs to remain useful and pleasant afterwards.** remain + 形容词表示继续保持某种状态。afterwards 指启用以后；这句话把注意力从一次开幕活动转到长期使用和维护。 ### 常用词与搭配 | 词与搭配 | 中文意思与常用结构 | 自然例句 | |---|---|---| | use public transport | 使用公共交通；use public transport to get to work | He uses public transport to get to work during the week. | | within walking distance of | 位于从某地步行可达的距离内；within walking distance of the station | The library is within walking distance of the bus station. | | meet housing needs | 满足住房需要；meet the housing needs of different households | The plan considers how to meet the housing needs of different households. | | provide green spaces | 提供绿地空间；provide green spaces for residents | The neighbourhood plan provides green spaces for residents to use. | | travel to and from work | 往返工作地点；通勤；travel to and from work by bus | Residents sometimes change buses when they travel to and from work. | | afford the rent | 负担得起租金；be able to afford the rent | We can afford the rent, but we still need to check the travel costs. | | traffic congestion | 交通拥堵；reduce traffic congestion | The buses are often delayed by traffic congestion near the centre. | | bus frequency | 公交班次频率；increase bus frequency | Higher bus frequency would shorten the wait between services. | | change buses | 换乘公交车；change buses at the station | I change buses at the station on my way to work. | | step-free access | 不用经过台阶的通行方式；provide step-free access | The new entrance provides step-free access to the library. | | maintain public facilities | 维护公共设施；maintain public facilities throughout the year | The town needs staff to maintain public facilities throughout the year. | | local amenities | 附近供日常生活使用的设施与服务；have useful local amenities nearby | The area has useful local amenities, including shops and a library. | ### 几个容易混淆的用法 **convenient / comfortable**：convenient 强调办事、出行方便；comfortable 强调身体或心理上的舒适。The flat is convenient for the station, but the bedroom is not very comfortable. 地点方便与住得舒服是不同条件。 **traffic / transport**：traffic 常指道路上的车流，通常不可数；transport 指交通或运输方式与服务。There is heavy traffic today, so public transport is running slowly. 不说 many traffics 来表示车辆多。 **near / within walking distance**：near 只说明近，具体距离依情境而定；within walking distance 表示可以步行到达。若要说得更清楚，可以用 The shop is a ten-minute walk from home. 实际路线上的台阶或过街条件还可另外说明。
可选回顾：一个公园就在家附近，是否就一定方便每个人使用？

The entrance, paths and opening hours also matter. A nearby park may still be difficult to use if the route has steps or it is closed when people are free.

距离只是一个条件；怎么进入、开放时间是否合适，也会影响实际使用。

可选回顾：公交班次变多，是否就表示每辆车开得更快？试用一句英文分清。

The buses run more frequently, but that does not necessarily mean they travel faster.

more frequently 说班次出现得更频繁；faster 说车辆行进速度。首末班时间、换乘和拥堵还会影响整段出行，不能只凭班次推出所有人的通勤都会缩短相同时间。

learning_outcomes: 比较居住地点时，能把租金与通勤时间、交通费用或附近服务联系起来说明。
区分站点距离、班次频率与通行速度，不把其中一项当成整个出行体验。
根据一个公共空间案例，指出入口、开放时间和维护中至少两项会影响实际使用的条件。
